title: 污染土壤洗滌
summary: 本課以「追蹤污染物在粗土、細泥與洗液間的分配以評估土壤洗滌」為主軸，依序處理場址分區與代表樣本、乾基污染庫存、洗液負荷與水循環、含水與產品重量、泵送與洗滌能耗。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Evaluate soil washing by following contamination among coarse soil, fines and wash water, progressing through Site zones and representative samples, Dry-basis contaminant inventory, Wash-water load and recycle, Moisture and product mass, Pumping and washing energy. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 場址分區與代表樣本：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Site zones and representative samples: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 場址分區與代表樣本 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Site zones and representative samples and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先用歷史活動和粒徑區分土壤群，避免把不相容污染混成平均樣。 網格數需向上取整；空間覆蓋與熱點偵測機率是不同的採樣設計問題。
steps.instructionEn: Group soils by history and size before sampling, avoiding composites that hide incompatible contaminants. Grid counts round upward; spatial coverage and hotspot detection probability are different sampling-design questions.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：抽樣區域 A=10000 m²；每格面積 a=400 m²。公式 N=ceil(A/a)，計算得 25 sample cells。適用邊界：規則平面網格計數，未指定法規採樣密度或統計信賴。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Survey area A=10000 m²; grid-cell area a=400 m². Formula N=ceil(A/a) gives 25 sample cells. Applicability: Regular planar-grid counting, not a regulatory density or statistical confidence claim.
steps.failure: 規則網格漏掉小型污染熱點，需與歷史與現場證據合併。 在「場址分區與代表樣本」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: A regular grid may miss small hotspots and must be combined with history and field evidence. Mark where this error can enter the Site zones and representative samples flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「場址分區與代表樣本」，將網格覆在地形與歷史活動圖上，保留障礙區與針對性樣本的理由。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Site zones and representative samples, Overlay the grid on terrain and historical activities; document inaccessible cells and targeted samples. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 污染細粒與粒徑分級：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Contaminated fines and size classification: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 污染細粒與粒徑分級 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Contaminated fines and size classification and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 細粒高比表面常富集吸附污染物，洗滌可將它們集中而非化學消滅。 粒徑分級先改變後續處理對象；篩孔名目尺寸不等於每顆粒都能通過的保證。
steps.instructionEn: High-surface-area fines often concentrate sorbed contaminants; washing can concentrate rather than destroy them. Size classification changes the downstream feed; nominal aperture is not a guarantee that every smaller particle passes.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：進料 m=1000 kg；細粒比例 f=0.30；細粒捕集率 r=0.90。公式 mf=m*f*r，計算得 270 kg。適用邊界：只算細粒回收，不含粗粒誤入及顆粒團聚。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Feed m=1000 kg; fines fraction f=0.30; fines capture r=0.90. Formula mf=m*f*r gives 270 kg. Applicability: Fines recovery only; coarse misplacement and agglomeration are omitted.
steps.failure: 濕料結團讓可回收細粒留在粗料中。 在「污染細粒與粒徑分級」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Wet agglomeration retains recoverable fines in the coarse stream. Mark where this error can enter the Contaminated fines and size classification flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「污染細粒與粒徑分級」，分別量進料與兩出口的粒徑分布，檢查堵孔、含水與旁通。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Contaminated fines and size classification, Measure feed and both outlet size distributions, checking blinded apertures, moisture and bypass. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
